finite_diagnostic.scope: Fixed-prior Monte Carlo estimates of explicit statistical rules, not neural training or worst-case validation

scope_limits: The three mathematical units concern a fixed clean population objective and a supplied-feature one-bias model. They do not prove learned attention, general SGD behavior, finite-precision training or a new general statistical principle.
The 55-page consolidated manuscript and all prior published scientific bytes remain unchanged. This is a separate later research stage.

Exact population gradients and real arithmetic are unpriced analytical interfaces. Fixed-horizon convergence does not provide a uniform-in-horizon iteration bound or monotone robustness along unconstrained training.

The finite experiment reports prior averages and approximate pointwise Monte Carlo intervals, not simultaneous coverage, worst-case risks, asymptotic rate fits or proof verification. Zero observed gate rejections do not establish zero probability.

The publisher verified frozen identities, source resolution, syntax, privacy, navigation and the scientific PNG display. Source receipts record independent scientific reviews and isolated replays; the publisher did not rerun those experiments or proofs during export.

Reviews are source-bound independent LLM reviews, not external peer review, formal verification or novelty certification. Historical candidate/pending/local-unpublished labels remain original chronological evidence; final acceptance is in the accompanying receipts.

The failed pre-implementation tests are preserved, with only absolute host prefixes removed from eight traceback lines. Administrative checks expecting the original failure-log hash are pre-export evidence; the current public manifest verifies its exported identity.

Run reproducibility commands in an isolated writable copy. The sealed experiment checks unchanged PRE_RUN_HASHES and can run from its canonical experiment directory with the sibling CTO sources. Do not rerun prepare, which replaces protocol timestamps. The retained nested replay program is required by the independent scalar checker, not a second complete standalone sealed-run directory. That checker also expects omitted duplicate replay CSV/PNG outputs and the original failure-log hash, so its unchanged command is recorded pre-export evidence, not an immediately runnable public check.

The CTO, PGT and PBF mathematical diagnostic programs have complete exact public inputs. Two ancillary BCJ source references resolve from local recovery aliases to existing public paths; the original literature reconciliation note has one previously declared nonmathematical export difference. Historical candidate and pending labels remain unmodified. The frozen original Chinese summary retained an earlier two-proof count; the public reader copy changes that phrase to the corresponding mathematical proofs. This single editorial count clarification changes no theorem, code, data or scope, and its exact original/export identity is recorded.

No later research, additional manuscript revision, private routing, original prompts, approval records, third-party paper PDFs, new license, workflow change, credentials or permissions are included. Historic missing-source boundaries remain unchanged.
CI validates the exact public inventory and integrity rejection cases, not mathematical correctness.
